captions.speaker: fighter1
captions.text: I used spies to rule the world, you got played by one instead

captions.speaker: fighter1
captions.text: The Times says she's a suspect, and you admitted you were in her bed

captions.speaker: fighter1
captions.text: Your board said " you're out," then " come back" in eleven days

captions.speaker: fighter1
captions.text: My generals never flip-flopped, they just obeyed my ways

captions.speaker: fighter1
captions.text: They say a coworker too, now HR's got a horde

captions.speaker: fighter1
captions.text: I had a hundred wives, but I never had a board

captions.speaker: fighter1
captions.text: You guard the world's top chips but you couldn't guard your own

captions.speaker: fighter1
captions.text: I ran the best spy network, bro, you got played on your phone

captions.speaker: fighter2
captions.text: Your wife got snatched in your own camp, bro, you couldn't guard her bed

captions.speaker: fighter2
captions.text: Then your own son called your firstborn a bastard to your head

captions.speaker: fighter2
captions.text: You burned whole cities down, then died of who-knows-what

captions.speaker: fighter2
captions.text: Fever, fall, or arrow, bro, they buried you and forgot

captions.speaker: fighter2
captions.text: I slipped, I owned it, and the whole world brought me back

captions.speaker: fighter2
captions.text: Your empire split in four the second you went black

captions.speaker: fighter2
captions.text: Eight hundred years, no tomb, no wife you could protect, no son you could trust

captions.speaker: fighter2
captions.text: I'm the king of the cloud, you're a statue and some dust
